title: VeloraOS 1.16.0 - Platform Update
releaseNotes: Adds Activity Centre with live and persistent background-operation history across updates, transfers, automations and local intelligence.
Adds Velora Flow with manual, hourly and daily automations, safe actions, run history and Time Machine integration.
Adds the permissioned Velora Plugin SDK with declarative Command Palette contributions and explicit capability grants.
Adds private Local Intelligence for summaries, tags, tasks, classification, filename suggestions and local Knowledge reranking.
